name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2025-12-30, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 4.13 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
